patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Square Online and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Square Online only if your buying job matches “Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, ” rather than Wix's shape. Choose Wix only if your buying job matches “Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell onlin” rather than Square Online's shape. Workflow advantage: Square Online leans omnichannel-retail; Wix leans checkout-conversion, catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Square Online and Wix share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Square Online is Square ecosystem online store — Free $0/mo (higher online processing), Plus $49/location, Premium $149/location; 30-day trials on paid tiers; Wix is Website-first builder with ecommerce from Core — Light $17/mo annual, Core $29 (sell online), Business $39, Business Elite $159 (annual tile.
- Workflow coverage skew: Square Online-leaning omnichannel-retail vs Wix-leaning checkout-conversion, catalog-management, website-builder-commerce.
- Researched limits: Square Online — Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Wix — Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B.

Limitations — Square Online: Best fit inside Square POS ecosystem — weaker as standalone SaaS platform vs Shopify; Free tier online processing spread (3.3% + 30¢) can exceed paid-tier savings at volume; Wix: Website-builder commerce depth trails Shopify-class platforms on complex catalogs and B2B; Plan gates for selling start at Core — Free/Light are not store plans.
